CONVERSATION_EXPORT.DESCRIPTION: Export all conversation messages within a date range to a CSV file.
CONVERSATION_EXPORT.REVIEWS_HELP: CSV files include AI and customer reviews for each ticket. Update reviews in a saved export without exporting its messages again.
CONVERSATION_EXPORT.REVIEWS_STARTED: Updating reviews in the saved CSV. The current file remains available until the update finishes.
CONVERSATION_EXPORT.REVIEWS_UPDATED: Reviews updated. Download the CSV to get the latest reviews.
CONVERSATION_EXPORT.VALIDATION: Pick both a from and to date, with from on or before to.
CONVERSATION_EXPORT.RANGE_VALIDATION: Dates must be between {min} and {max}. Check the year.
